to accept and start to use something new

grammar_choice.en_template: It is evident through various case studies {{1:that/what}} adopting digital minimalism can {{2:lead to/lead}} improved mental health outcomes.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 디지털 미니멀리즘을 받아들이는 것이 향상된 정신 건강 결과로 이어질 수 있다는 것은 다양한 사례 연구를 통해 분명하다.
explain: It is evident ~의 진주어 명사절 — 완전한 절을 이끄는 접속사 that.
lead to N: ~로 이어지다(타동사구), to 필요.

grammar_choice.en_template: For instance, a study {{1:conducted/conducting}} by researchers at Stanford University found that participants {{2:who/which}} limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 예를 들어, 스탠퍼드 대학교 연구진이 수행한 한 연구는 소셜 미디어와 디지털 기기 사용을 제한한 참가자들이 더 낮은 수준의 스트레스, 불안, 우울을 보고했음을 발견했다.
explain: a study가 수행'된' 대상 — 과거분사 conducted(= which was conducted).
선행사 participants(사람) + 뒤 절의 주어 역할 → 주격 who.

grammar_choice.en_template: By {{1:reducing/reduce}} the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities {{2:that/what}} promoted well-being.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 끊임없는 정보와 알림의 흐름을 줄임으로써, 개인들은 의미 있는 상호작용과 행복을 증진하는 활동에 더 집중할 수 있었다.
explain: 선행사 activities를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that.

grammar_choice.en_template: Additionally, participants reported {{1:relying/to rely}} on social media to {{2:get/getting}} information for their purchasing decisions.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 게다가, 참가자들은 구매 결정을 위한 정보를 얻기 위해 소셜 미디어에 의존했다고 보고했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: In another case, a corporate professional {{1:struggling/struggled}} with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and {{2:practicing/practiced}} mindfulness.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 또 다른 사례에서, 번아웃과 불면증에 시달리던 한 직장인은 휴대전화 사용에 경계를 설정하고 마음챙김을 실천하는 등의 디지털 미니멀리즘 기법을 실행했다.
explain: 주어 a corporate professional을 후치 수식하는 현재분사 struggling.
such as 뒤 setting과 병렬 — 동명사 practicing.

grammar_choice.en_template: As a result, he {{1:experienced/experiencing}} improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a {{2:newfound/newly}} sense of calm and clarity.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그 결과, 그는 향상된 수면의 질, 줄어든 스트레스 수준, 그리고 새롭게 찾은 평온과 명료함을 경험했다.

jumble.answer: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes.

For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression.
By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being.
Additionally, participants reported relying on social media to get information for their purchasing decisions.
In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and practicing mindfulness.
As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
